items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And those are only the guys that I know of. ... I told Antonio Heart, I said, Antonio, man, I wish I could write.

ctx.x: But they -- they can vote for me and say something, but I hear people I like better than myself so if it was up to me -- Who did we vote for honey? Didn't we vote for someone? We voted for some people. Didn't we vote for who? LINDA: Oh, in the Reader's poll?
Yeah. LINDA: We voted for Slide (phonetic sp.).
